messages.subject: Fireworks: final numbers
messages.bodyPreview: We have eighteen stewards confirmed. If you can still help on the night of the display, meet Imogen at the bandstand at 18:00.

messages.subject: Crown lift quote
messages.bodyPreview: Please find our quote to crown-lift the twelve limes on the riverside path. We can start the week after next.

messages.subject: September grounds report
messages.bodyPreview: Attached is our September report. All grass cutting was on schedule; two hedges were delayed by the rain.

messages.subject: Springer delivery
messages.bodyPreview: The replacement springer for Saxon Rise will be delivered to the parks yard on Thursday.

messages.subject: Memorial bench for my husband
messages.bodyPreview: Thank you for talking me through the bench locations. I would like the spot facing the lodge garden.

messages.subject: Leaf clearance
messages.bodyPreview: The leaves on the Saxon Rise footpath are very slippery. Could they be cleared this week?

messages.subject: Bin replacement in the market square
messages.bodyPreview: We will replace the six bins on the north side of the market square next Tuesday morning.

messages.subject: Cemetery lodge roof
messages.bodyPreview: The roofers have confirmed Wednesday. The lodge office will work from the side door.
